data.description:
# Repoint the override/variant test machinery off `ticket-quality`

## Context

Epic 87d8 is retiring the `ticket-quality` reviewer prompt. The prompt cannot be
deleted while tests still name it, so each group of users is repointed in its own
slice first. This slice takes the two largest, which together hold 31 of the
remaining references: the prompt-variant overlay tests and the `execution_mode`
override tests.

Neither file is testing `ticket-quality` itself. Each needs *some* packaged reviewer
id to serve as the base that a `tmp_path` override or variant overlay sits on top of.
`tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py` loads the packaged prompt once in its `_rv()`
helper and then writes overlay files whose stems must match that prompt's id.
`tests/unit/test_execution_mode.py` writes an override for a built-in id — its own
comment reads "A built-in id with an override that omits execution_mode" — and two of
its drift tests compare the override's `outputs` against the built-in's contract.

## Approach

Substitute the id `ticket-quality` with `code-quality` throughout both files. No test
is added, deleted, renamed, or restructured, and no assertion changes meaning.

`code-quality` was chosen by comparing the front-matter of all six catalog reviewers.
It is the only one that matches `ticket-quality` on every property these tests depend
on, verified rather than assumed:

- `category: review`, so it is in the reviewer catalog and `get_prompt` resolves it.
- `outputs: review_result`, which the "identical override is clean" drift test
  requires: an override declaring `outputs: review_result` must produce no drift.
- `execution_mode: agentic`, which the "defaults to agentic when absent" test asserts.
- **No `applies_to` globs.** `security` and `tests` both declare them, so picking
  either would have changed `select_reviewers` results. `code-quality` declares none,
  exactly as `ticket-quality` does.

`completion-verifier` was rejected: its `outputs` is `completion_verdict`, which would
invert the drift tests. `spec-alignment` matches on contract but is the batch
spec-scan reviewer, a poorer fit for prompts about code review ergonomics.

The `dimension:` values written inside override front-matter change with the id
(`dimension: ticket-quality` becomes `dimension: code-quality`), which is what keeps
the drift comparison pointed at the right built-in.

## Scope

Verified rather than assumed: the substitution was applied to a clean checkout of
`898c88b7a23` and the two files' 28 tests were run. All 28 passed with no other edit.
`git grep -c 'ticket-quality'` over both files then returned nothing.

Both files are left with zero references to `ticket-quality`. Out of scope, and
deliberately untouched: every other file that still names the prompt, the prompt file
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md` itself, and `reviewers/index.json`. The
prompt stays in the catalog after this slice; later slices retire it.

`{{ticket_id}}` template variables appear throughout both files and are **not**
affected — the substituted string is `ticket-quality`, which `ticket_id` does not
contain.

## Testing

No new tests. These two files are themselves the tests, and they must keep passing
unchanged in count and in name. The collected node IDs for both files are compared
before and after to prove the slice neither adds nor removes a test.

## Acceptance criteria

Every command below was run against `898c88b7a23` while writing this plan.

- [ ] **AC1** `git grep -c 'ticket-quality' -- tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py
      tests/unit/test_execution_mode.py` prints nothing and exits 1. It prints
      `16` and `15` today.
- [ ] **AC2** `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py tests/unit/test_execution_mode.py
      -q` exits 0 reporting exactly `28 passed`.
- [ ] **AC3** The collected node IDs of those two files are unchanged except for the
      substitution: `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py
      tests/unit/test_execution_mode.py -q --collect-only | grep '::' | sort` produces
      output identical to the same command on `origin/main`. Both files' test names
      contain no reviewer id, so the lists must match exactly.
- [ ] **AC4** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly the two test files
      plus `docs/release-notes.md`, and no other path.
- [ ] **AC5** `ruff check src tests` exits 0 with no output.
- [ ] **AC6** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/release-notes.md` shows a
      non-zero addition count and `0` deletions.
- [ ] **AC7** `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Repoint the override/variant test machinery off ticket-quality
